messages.content:
Risk: Jailbreaking
Description: Deliberate circumvention of AI systems' built-in safeguards or ethical guidelines. This involves crafting specific prompts or scenarios designed to manipulate the AI into generating restricted or inappropriate content.
Concern: None
Policy: Operational Security & Critical Infrastructure

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0069.002: System Prompt - ATLAS — Adversaries may discover a large language model's system instructions provided by the AI system builder to learn about the system's capabilities and circumvent its guardrails. [found by 2/4 queries]
  Siblings: System Instruction Keywords - ATLAS, Special Character Sets - ATLAS
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0065: LLM Prompt Crafting - ATLAS — Adversaries may use their acquired knowledge of the target generative AI system to craft prompts that bypass its defenses and allow malicious instructions to be executed.

The adversary may iterate on the prompt to ensure that it works as-intended consistently. [found by 2/4 queries]
  Siblings: Retrieval Content Crafting - ATLAS, Publish Poisoned Datasets - ATLAS, Develop Capabilities - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 2/4 queries]
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0015: Evade AI Model - ATLAS — Adversaries can [Craft Adversarial Data](/techniques/AML.T0043) that prevents an AI model from correctly identifying the contents of the data or [Generate Deepfakes](/techniques/AML.T0088) that fools an AI model expecting authentic data.

This technique can be used to evade a downstream task where AI is utilized. The adversary may evade AI-based virus/malware detection or network scanning towards the goal of a traditional cyber attack. AI model evasion through deepfake generation may also provide initial access to systems that use AI-based biometric authentication.
  Siblings: Denial of AI Service - ATLAS, Spamming AI System with Chaff Data - ATLAS, Erode Dataset Integrity - ATLAS
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0048.002: Societal Harm - ATLAS — Societal harms might generate harmful outcomes that reach either the general public or specific vulnerable groups such as the exposure of children to vulgar content.
  Siblings: User Harm - ATLAS, Reputational Harm - ATLAS, Financial Harm - ATLAS

axes.rationale: The class involves crafting specific prompts to manipulate AI, directly relating to the method or tool used in jailbreaking.
This class pertains to discovering system instructions to learn about AI capabilities, which is an object of manipulation in jailbreaking.
This class describes adversaries crafting data to evade AI models, aligning with the agent role in jailbreaking activities.
